description:
Voices for personas and videos. list: the 65 English house voices, each with a text description plus gender/accent/kind (filter with gender, origin, search such as "deep calm"); the voiceId of a persona or video is one of these ids, a label, or a ready clone. preview: a short MP3 of a house voice, optionally with your own text (10 previews a day). Clones: list_clones, create_clone (from an HTTPS audioUrl or a local audioPath; needs explicit consent), get_clone (poll until ready), preview_clone, delete_clone.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); preview (voiceId); list_clones (no required fields); create_clone (language, consent, denoise); get_clone (cloneId); preview_clone (cloneId); delete_clone (cloneId).

action.description: What to do: list | preview | list_clones | create_clone | get_clone | preview_clone | delete_clone. The description lists the fields each action needs.

audioPath.description: Local file path of a short reference recording on this computer (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, or .webm, max 20MB). Send exactly one of audioUrl or audioPath.

audioUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a short reference recording (MP3, WAV, M4A, or WebM, max 20MB). Send exactly one of audioUrl or audioPath.

cloneId.description: Cloned voice id (the id returned by voices (action: create_clone) or voices (action: list_clones))

consent.description: Must be true: caller confirms consent to voice cloning

denoise.description: Clean background noise from the recording before cloning (recommended true; false for studio audio)

language.description: Language code for the clone — English only for now (e.g. en, en-us)

origin.description: us = American English, gb = British English, character = character voices

search.description: Words to match in the voice name or description, e.g. "deep calm", "pirate", "british warm"

text.description: Optional words for the house voice to speak (1-300 chars, English). Omit to hear the fixed sample. Previews are free and limited to 10 per user per day.

voiceId.description: House voice id from voices (action: list) (e.g. chatterbox:phonon_zoey)

name: voices
